top_signals.title: Banque du Caire Offers 30% Stake in Egypt’s Second IPO in Month
top_signals.summary: Banque du Caire will sell a 30% stake via Egypt’s stock exchange, a long-awaited state-asset sale that would also be the country’s second major initial public offering in a month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
